points.titleSub: (Turning up on the days you do not want to)

body.text: The session you do at sixty percent on a bad day counts more than the one you skip and plan to make up on Sunday.
It exists to check that the batch endpoint sends ten decks to TikTok in one call. Delete it when that is confirmed.
